description: Generated from P4 SafetyRuleCatalog.def; do not edit manually

rules.title: Invalid servo command structure
rules.recovery: Check batch size, Mxx indices, and command source.

rules.title: Servo bus route is unknown
rules.recovery: Wait for route scanning to finish or check servo power.

rules.title: Servo ID conflicts across buses
rules.recovery: Remove the duplicate ID or assign it to only one bus.

rules.title: Servo bus capacity exceeded
rules.recovery: Connect no more than 10 servos to each bus.

rules.title: E-STOP is latched
rules.recovery: Confirm mechanical safety, then press ENABLE again.

rules.title: Command producer does not own output
rules.recovery: Check mode switching and owner release.

rules.title: System state rejects this servo command
rules.recovery: Return to the matching DIRECT, FEEDBACK, or calibration state.

rules.title: Target servo is offline
rules.recovery: Check power, bus wiring, and servo ID.

rules.title: Servo multi-turn position is untrusted
rules.recovery: Wait for JSON nearest-turn recovery; if it still fails, select the affected joint and recalibrate.

rules.title: Servo target is stale
rules.recovery: Check task blocking and the control producer period.

rules.title: Target exceeds the logical range
rules.recovery: Check ABS recovery, the reachable range, and upper-layer angle conversion.

rules.title: Target exceeds servo hardware travel
rules.recovery: Check servo ABS recovery and the hardware travel limits.

rules.title: Servo turn count reached the safety limit
rules.recovery: Select the affected joint and recalibrate.

rules.title: CAN or magnetic encoder feedback unavailable
rules.recovery: Check S3, CAN wiring, and feedback freshness.

rules.title: Invalid control joint index
rules.recovery: Check HardwareMap and joint loop bounds.

rules.title: Target joint encoder fault
rules.recovery: Check the affected encoder and S3 sensor state.

rules.title: Invalid mapped joint angle
rules.recovery: Check Manual/Auto calibration and angle mapping.

rules.title: Insufficient joint motion triggered collision hold
rules.recovery: Confirm whether the hand contacted an object; a reverse target releases the hold.

rules.title: Dual-tendon PID output reached the LUT extension limit
rules.recovery: Check target angle, dual-tendon LUT calibration, and the 500-count runtime margin.

rules.title: Joint target exceeds the current dynamic range
rules.recovery: Check the requested target and current calibration range; recovery is automatic when the target returns in range.

rules.title: Joint feedback exceeded the Current Max warning boundary
rules.recovery: Check mechanical assembly, encoder direction, and Auto Max; recovery is automatic when feedback returns in range.

rules.title: Servo held at current ABS after hot-plug recovery
rules.recovery: Confirm trusted multi-turn state, then send an explicit target to release the hold.

rules.title: Host control lease expired
rules.recovery: Check the desktop process, serial connection, and blocked tasks.

rules.title: Current state rejected START
rules.recovery: Resolve the active task or fault before retrying.

rules.title: Current state rejected direct control
rules.recovery: Switch to a state that permits DIRECT control.

rules.title: Current state rejected feedback control
rules.recovery: Complete Rope Init and wait for READY.

rules.title: Current state rejected automatic calibration
rules.recovery: Stop other motion tasks before retrying.

rules.title: Direct-control state admission failed
rules.recovery: Stop the current task, then enable direct control again.

rules.title: Selected direct-control servo is unavailable
rules.recovery: Check selected servo online state and bus routing.

rules.title: Selected direct-control servo has unknown multi-turn state
rules.recovery: Wait for JSON nearest-turn recovery; recalibrate if recovery still fails.

rules.title: Direct-control state event queue is full
rules.recovery: Check for a blocked state machine and retry later.

rules.title: Direct-control command generation is stale
rules.recovery: Wait for mode switching to complete, then send the command again.

rules.title: System fault blocks direct control
rules.recovery: Resolve the status-bar fault, then press ENABLE again.

rules.title: Feedback control is missing Manual references
rules.recovery: Enter Manual Min and Max for the selected joints in Device Check.

rules.title: Feedback-control state admission failed
rules.recovery: Wait for READY, then retry.

rules.title: Joint is outside the dynamic workspace
rules.recovery: Run Rope Init to move the selected joints into READY.

rules.title: Selected feedback-control servo has unknown multi-turn state
rules.recovery: Wait for JSON nearest-turn recovery; recalibrate if recovery still fails.

rules.title: Feedback control is missing valid ABS or LUT limits
rules.recovery: Run automatic calibration again or load a matching snapshot.

rules.title: Control mode switch is not complete
rules.recovery: Wait for owner release, then send the target again.

rules.title: Feedback-control state event queue is full
rules.recovery: Check for a blocked state machine and retry later.

rules.title: CAN readiness gate failed
rules.recovery: Check S3, CAN wiring, and magnetic encoder feedback.

rules.title: READY multi-turn gate failed
rules.recovery: Wait for JSON nearest-turn recovery or recalibrate.

rules.title: READY active scope is empty
rules.recovery: Select at least one joint in Joint Channels.

rules.title: READY is missing a mapped-angle snapshot
rules.recovery: Check CAN feedback and mapped-angle publishing.

rules.title: READY is missing Auto calibration
rules.recovery: Run automatic calibration for the selected joints.

rules.title: READY mapped angle is invalid
rules.recovery: Check Manual/Auto direction and span.

rules.title: Joint is below the dynamic workspace
rules.recovery: Run Rope Init.

rules.title: Manual and Auto calibration versions do not match
rules.recovery: Run automatic calibration again for the affected joint.

rules.title: Active joint has an encoder or CAN fault
rules.recovery: Check the affected encoder and CAN link.

rules.title: System fault blocks READY
rules.recovery: Resolve the fault bits, then evaluate READY again.

rules.title: Servo turn overflow blocks READY
rules.recovery: Select the affected joint and recalibrate.

rules.title: Rope Init timed out
rules.recovery: Check tendon routing, winding direction, and workspace boundaries.

rules.title: Rope Init feedback is stale
rules.recovery: Check servo and magnetic encoder feedback periods.

rules.title: Servo went offline during Rope Init
rules.recovery: Check power and bus communication for the affected servo.

rules.title: Rope Init has unknown multi-turn state
rules.recovery: Wait for JSON nearest-turn recovery or recalibrate.

rules.title: Rope Init is missing Manual data
rules.recovery: Enter Manual data in Device Check.

rules.title: Rope Init is missing Auto calibration
rules.recovery: Run automatic calibration for the affected joint first.

rules.title: Rope Init target publish failed
rules.recovery: Check owner state, message channel, and the servo task.

rules.title: System fault aborted Rope Init
rules.recovery: Resolve the system fault, then retry.

rules.title: Mode switching cancelled Rope Init
rules.recovery: Confirm the operation sequence, then start again.

rules.title: CAN link offline fault
rules.recovery: Restore S3 and CAN communication.

rules.title: Servo overload fault
rules.recovery: Remove mechanical binding or tendon blockage, then clear the fault.

rules.title: Active servo offline fault
rules.recovery: Restore power and routing for the affected servo.

rules.title: Automatic calibration failure
rules.recovery: Resolve the calibration diagnostic cause, then clear the fault.

rules.title: Unknown multi-turn position fault
rules.recovery: Wait for JSON nearest-turn recovery; recalibrate if recovery still fails.

rules.title: Calibration active scope is empty
rules.recovery: Select at least one joint.

rules.title: Encoder error during calibration
rules.recovery: Check the affected encoder and S3 error code.

rules.title: Servo offline during calibration
rules.recovery: Check servo power, ID, and bus wiring.

rules.title: Calibration load is too high
rules.recovery: Check for blocked tendon routing or mechanical interference.

rules.title: Invalid encoder wrap during calibration
rules.recovery: Check Manual direction and the wrap path.

rules.title: Calibration encoder wrap span is abnormal
rules.recovery: Check encoder readings and mechanical travel.

rules.title: Calibration ABS limit is invalid
rules.recovery: Check multi-turn coordinates and LUT endpoints.

rules.title: Calibration target publish failed
rules.recovery: Check owner state, message channel, and the servo task.

rules.title: Feedback lost during calibration
rules.recovery: Check servo and magnetic encoder feedback freshness.

rules.title: Automatic calibration task creation failed
rules.recovery: Check memory, stack, and task resources.

rules.title: Calibration lost output ownership
rules.recovery: Check mode switching and E-STOP operation order.

rules.title: Failed to hold non-active joints
rules.recovery: Check active scope and servo feedback.

rules.title: Calibration joint list is invalid
rules.recovery: Check the active joint mask.

rules.title: Calibration joint list contains duplicates
rules.recovery: Remove duplicate joint selections.

rules.title: Dual-tendon workspace preparation failed
rules.recovery: Check helper dual-tendon motors, online state, and multi-turn state.

rules.title: Joint calibration step failed
rules.recovery: Inspect phase and valueA/valueB/valueC diagnostics.

rules.title: Timed out waiting for servo recovery during calibration
rules.recovery: Check hot-plug recovery and Turn Unknown state.

rules.title: Single tendon released more than two turns
rules.recovery: Check tendon routing and initial assembly before recalibrating.

rules.title: Calibration motor mapping is invalid
rules.recovery: Check J/M topology and dual-tendon primary/secondary mapping.

rules.title: Calibration result travel is invalid
rules.recovery: Check encoder direction, mechanical endpoints, and effective travel.

rules.title: Calibration result build failed
rules.recovery: Check Manual references, endpoints, and LUT samples.

rules.title: Calibration result commit failed
rules.recovery: Check runtime calibration storage and the joint index.

rules.title: Calibration multi-turn trust commit failed
rules.recovery: Check servo online state, multi-turn configuration, and recovery state.

rules.title: Joint stalled during dual-tendon exchange
rules.recovery: Check antagonistic tendon preload, exchange direction, encoder feedback, and mechanical binding.

rules.title: Auto Min offset from Manual Min is insufficient
rules.recovery: Check release-side finger assembly clearance.

rules.title: Auto Max offset from Manual Max is insufficient
rules.recovery: Check tightened-side finger assembly clearance.

rules.title: URDF and Manual span difference exceeds the limit
rules.recovery: Check Manual endpoints and mechanical assembly.

rules.title: CAN driver initialization failed
rules.recovery: Check TWAI pins, power, and driver installation, then restart P4.

rules.title: CAN frame length or identifier is invalid
rules.recovery: Check S3/P4 protocol versions and CAN bus interference.

rules.title: Encoder batch CRC or fragment is invalid
rules.recovery: Check CAN packet loss, CRC, and the S3 encoder publish period.

rules.title: Tactile batch CRC or fragment is invalid
rules.recovery: Check tactile fragment order, CRC, and CAN bandwidth.

rules.title: Desktop protocol frame was rejected
rules.recovery: Check protocol version, command length, frame tail, and serial noise.

rules.title: Safety event cache overflow
rules.recovery: Export recent safety events and check for a high-frequency repeated rule.

rules.title: System queue creation failed
rules.recovery: Check heap memory and queue capacity, then restart P4.

rules.title: System mutex creation failed
rules.recovery: Check heap memory and do not start business tasks.

rules.title: Critical task creation failed
rules.recovery: Check task stack, priority, and available memory.

rules.title: Real-time task repeatedly exceeded its period
rules.recovery: Check blocking calls, serial output, and task priority.

rules.title: Real-time task stack is low
rules.recovery: Increase task stack or reduce large local objects, then validate again.
